What if [expected utility maximization over a defined domain](utility_if_we_must.qmd) is not the model of intelligence?
What if, rather, it is [dangerously misleading](bitter_lesson_erm.qmd) to bet too hard on intelligence as a single-point optimization process?
This page collects the non-utility alternatives: entities that [persist rather than optimize](utility_fitness.qmd), and agents that manufacture their own goals through [intrinsic motivation](intrinsic_motivation.qmd).
This page is about a third idea that draws on both but lives at the level of the whole process — open-endedness.

## Open-endedness

What does it mean for a system to be “open-ended”?

[Jeff Clune](https://vectorinstitute.ai/new-vector-faculty-member-jeff-clunes-quest-to-create-open-ended-ai-systems/) posed a version of this question at [EXAIT](https://exait-workshop.github.io):

> Could we devise an open-ended exploratory algorithm that is worth running for a billion years?

This isn’t about solving a single benchmark or reaching a single target loss.
It’s about building processes that *never finish* and that continually create novelty, complexity, and surprise.
That’s what life itself appears to be building.

Implementations

* [POET](https://www.uber.com/en-AU/blog/poet-open-ended-deep-learning/): endlessly generates new environments and their solutions in tandem [@Wang2019POET; @Wang2020Enhanced; @Ecoffet2021First].
* _Quality-diversity algorithms_: not just about finding a single optimum but about filling out the space of possible strategies [@Cully2015Robots].
* [OMNI-EPIC](https://omni-epic.vercel.app/): links human notions of interestingness with programmatically generated environments [@Faldor2024OMNIEPIC].
  See also [maxencefaldor/omni-epic](https://github.com/maxencefaldor/omni-epic)
* Broader frameworks in _AI-GA_ (AI generating algorithms) [@Clune2020AIGAs].

These approaches move away from a single-point optimization worldview toward something more like evolution: messy, self-propagating, self-diversifying, and driven by the imperatives of persistence and exploration.
